title: Northgate Protect Claim Filing Deadline, Channels and Decision Time
content:
A Northgate Protect claim must be filed within a set number of calendar days after the incident date, through one of the tier's claim channels, and the administrator, Keystone Protection Services, decides a filed claim within a set number of business days.

| Tier | Calendar days after the incident date to file | Business days for the administrator's decision | Claim channels |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Protect Standard 2-Year | 30 | 3 | Online, phone |
| Northgate Protect Standard 3-Year | 30 | 3 | Online, phone |
| Northgate Protect Accident 2-Year | 30 | 3 | Online, phone |
| Northgate Protect Accident 3-Year | 30 | 3 | Online, phone |
| Northgate Protect Accident 4-Year | 30 | 3 | Online, phone |
| Northgate Protect Complete Monthly | 30 | 3 | Online, phone, app |

- The filing period is 30 calendar days on every tier; the decision period is 3 business days on every tier.
- Filing in the Northgate app is available on Northgate Protect Complete Monthly only; the single-item tiers take claims online or by phone.
